affiliations.date_precision: Civilian-occupation code 685 was recorded at Army entry on 26 October 1942; no employer, workplace or OSS transfer date is identified.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier and name confirm identity. The historical code wording is published as an occupation only, never as a named employer or immediate OSS predecessor.

affiliations.date_precision: Civilian-occupation code 120 was recorded at Army entry on 27 March 1943; no employer, library or OSS transfer date is identified.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier confirms the indexed person despite the Army file's Le Vern spacing. The occupation is not converted into employment at an unnamed library.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Joseph Cusumano is confirmed as the exact person recorded entering the United States Army on October 26, 1942.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: One of five exact-name Army rows carries the private identifier printed in the OSS index.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact private identifier and exact normalized name; four name-only Army rows are excluded.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army-entry record is dated 26 October 1942; the OSS transfer date is unknown.
claims.match_notes: The full private identifier remains private. Entry grade supports enlisted classification but does not exclude later promotion.
